ui_intro: A short film without sound: everything is shown as text on screen. You can pause at any time or pick a chapter.
k1_sub: Articulated lorry: the vehicle stands straight.
k1_p1: The vehicle stands in a straight line, if possible.
k1_p2: Leave space in front of the tractor unit so it can later be coupled straight again.
k1b_p1: When the vehicle stands, the parking brake of the tractor unit is applied first.
k1b_p2: Then that of the semi-trailer: pull the red knob.
k1b_p3: Wheel chocks are also placed at a rigid axle.
k2_sub: The semi-trailer must then stand securely.
k2_p1: The landing gear is extended: with air suspension until the feet touch the ground, with leaf springs until the tractor unit's springs are relieved.
k2_p2: The ground must bear the load. Otherwise the feet are packed underneath.
k2_p3: The semi-trailer is not lifted off the fifth wheel coupling.
k3_p1: Red is disconnected first: the supply line.
k3_p2: Then comes yellow: the brake line.
k3_p3: The electrical cable is disconnected as well. The heads go into the parking sockets.
k3_p4: When red is disconnected, the trailer brakes automatically. That is not enough to secure it.
k3_p5: The air is lost over time. That is why the parking brake and chocks stay.
k4_p1: The lock of the fifth wheel coupling is released and the coupling is opened.
k4_p2: The tractor unit drives slowly and straight forward a short way.
k4_p3: With air suspension it is then lowered a little and drives out completely.
k4_p4: This way the rear of the tractor unit does not jump up.
k5_merk: Park in a straight line, both parking brakes, chocks, landing gear down. First red, then yellow off. Red alone does not secure.
